remarks: Located on an exceptional residential block of South Pasadena, 722 Brent Avenue is a well-maintained four-unit building offering long-term investment appeal. Prime, central location with a 93 Walker's Paradise Walk Score! Built in 1946, the property features four two-bedroom, one-bath residences. Each unit offers functional floorpans and charming architectural details to feel like a standalone home. Bonus: each unit has a private 1-car garage. Residents also enjoy access to a detached laundry room and a shared storage room.
